delivery_revision_exclusion.note: Post-review case repair is separate deliverable evidence, not a fresh method-level comparison and not evidence of superiority.

recommended_small_improvements.name: Constraint coverage before finalization
recommended_small_improvements.trigger: Visible input or generated instruction states comparison or operating conditions.
recommended_small_improvements.rule: Carry each material condition into the conclusion at the field where it matters; use only visible facts. Check identity, path, switching, mode, reference plane, baseline, time window, calibration and tolerance as applicable; mark unavailable conditions as missing.
recommended_small_improvements.borrow: One constrained Evol-Instruct-style refinement pass can make required comparisons explicit.
recommended_small_improvements.scope: Generic input-derived checklist; no hard-coded case IDs, numbers or answer text.

recommended_small_improvements.name: Claim-specific evidence roles and lineage
recommended_small_improvements.trigger: An evidence list mixes observations, ML inference and independent comparison.
recommended_small_improvements.rule: Bind every reference to the proposition it supports or contradicts. ML finding IDs may identify a candidate; they are not independent observation evidence. Preserve shared evidence lineage and explicit counterevidence. If the schema is unchanged, express roles in existing explanatory fields and keep supporting_refs limited to evidence for the stated claim.
recommended_small_improvements.borrow: Use the explicit evidence comparisons observed in M1; do not copy a competitor answer.
recommended_small_improvements.scope: Review all cases with the same rule, including cases whose original ratings were 20.

recommended_small_improvements.name: Small candidate-instruction selection, if budget permits
recommended_small_improvements.trigger: The development protocol explicitly permits multiple proposed instructions.
recommended_small_improvements.rule: Generate a fixed small number (for example three) of instructions from the same visible input, rank using relevance, clarity, executability plus evidence-role and constraint coverage, select once, then produce one answer. Treat self-ranking as generation, not independent evaluation.
addresses: Instruction specificity and omission prevention; effect remains untested.
recommended_small_improvements.scope: Record proposals, ranking, selected index and additional calls/tokens; otherwise no equal-compute claim.

recommended_small_improvements.name: One bounded consistency and repair pass
recommended_small_improvements.trigger: Generated answer fails a frozen, generic coverage/evidence-role checklist.
recommended_small_improvements.rule: Check generated instruction against target, preserve evidence boundaries and revise once. Keep original, revised output, hashes and reason separately.
addresses: M4 output did not explicitly fulfill its own same-path comparison instruction.
recommended_small_improvements.borrow: General output verification; G1 and G2 are the smallest necessary changes.
recommended_small_improvements.scope: Predefine iteration count and stopping rule; do not keep querying the scored development set until the method ranks first.

fairness_and_claim_ceilings: Four literature-derived synthetic development cases, one generated candidate per arm per case; no unseen test population or repeated generation seeds.

Two fresh sessions used the same configured reviewer model; they may have correlated errors. In the three leading arms, every score deduction came from reviewer A, while reviewer B scored all 12 candidates 20.
The 0/1/2 rubric is close to its ceiling: M4 loses two of 160 possible raw points and M1/M3 each lose one. Tiny rank changes do not establish method superiority or expected generalization.

Equal generator and case count are declared. Actual generation tokens, exact decoding settings and exact serving revision are unavailable; actual compute was not matched. M1 and M3 are style adaptations, not faithful reproductions of the original algorithms.
Scores assess fidelity to provided synthetic scenario material. They do not establish real physical correctness, source authenticity, causal diagnosis validity or downstream SFT benefit.
Zero human expert reviews, no downstream fine-tuning, no training authorization, no gold eligibility and no official split assignment.

The reviewed cases are now development data. Any method changes informed by these reviews must be evaluated on newly frozen, unseen cases; preserve the old comparison unchanged and disclose adaptive selection.

Method generators and evaluators should not see coordinator source bindings, hidden/reference targets, blocked historical text, other-arm outputs or each other's reviews. Source roles and temporal/history restrictions remain frozen for every arm.

The separate delivery-only repair has 20/20 from both reviewers but cannot replace the original M4 score in the primary comparison; it received post-review information and an additional repair opportunity.
